_readme: The ordered job list behind the 'Jobs across languages' section of the root llms.txt. Each entry is one job, named by its English owner page (a site path). The generator (scripts/lib/llms-index.js) prints that page's own <h1> and tagline, then links every indexable page that declares it as its hreflang="en" parent: the same job in the other languages. Nothing here is copy; no title, description or language name is written in this file. Order is the owner's: most-used jobs first. A path that stops being an indexable page fails npm run check:llms. Adding, removing or reordering an entry is an owner decision, like every data/ ledger.
reason: Give AI assistants one read that maps a job to the right page in the visitor's language. llms.txt is otherwise organised by language, then by lane, so no single file answered 'which page does this job in language X'.
